result.topic_en: Ramanujan's transformation formulas for series involving divisor sums sigma_{1-2r}(n) and e^{-2n alpha}, with alpha beta = pi^2, giving the Bernoulli-number evaluation, the r-independent logarithmic case (29), and a cosh-series identity (30) for alpha beta = pi^2/4.
result.transcription:
Add MS a 94 18 (63) \quad (63)

$= (4\alpha)^{1-r}\left\{\frac{1}{2}\zeta(2r-1) + \sigma_{1-2r}(1)e^{-2\alpha} + \sigma_{1-2r}(2)e^{-4\alpha} + \sigma_{1-2r}(3)e^{-6\alpha} + \cdots\right\}$
$-(-4\beta)^{1-r}\left\{\frac{1}{2}\zeta(2r-1) + \sigma_{1-2r}(1)e^{-2\beta} + \sigma_{1-2r}(2)e^{-4\beta} + \sigma_{1-2r}(3)e^{-6\beta} + \cdots\right\}$

$= \frac{B_{2r}}{(2r)!}\left\{(-\alpha)^r + \beta^r\right\} + \pi^2\frac{B_2}{2!}\frac{B_{2r-2}}{(2r-2)!}\left\{(-\alpha)^{r-2} + \beta^{r-2}\right\}$
$-\pi^4\frac{B_4}{4!}\frac{B_{2r-4}}{(2r-4)!}\left\{(-\alpha)^{r-4} + \beta^{r-4}\right\} + \cdots\cdots$
the last term being $-\pi^r\left(\frac{B_r}{r!}\right)^2(-1)^{r/2}$ or $\pi^{r-1}\frac{B_{r-1}}{(r-1)!}\frac{B_{r+1}}{(r+1)!}(-1)^{\frac{r+1}{2}}(\beta-\alpha)$
according as $r$ is even or odd. Lastly equating the terms
independent of $r$ in both sides in (21) we have, when $\alpha\beta=\pi^2$,

(29) $\left\{\frac{1}{1(e^{2\alpha}-1)} + \frac{1}{2(e^{4\alpha}-1)} + \frac{1}{3(e^{6\alpha}-1)} + \cdots\right\}$
$-\left\{\frac{1}{1(e^{2\beta}-1)} + \frac{1}{2(e^{4\beta}-1)} + \frac{1}{3(e^{6\beta}-1)} + \cdots\right\}$
$= \left\{\sigma_{-1}(1)e^{-2\alpha} + \sigma_{-1}(2)e^{-4\alpha} + \sigma_{-1}(3)e^{-6\alpha} + \cdots\right\}$
$-\left\{\sigma_{-1}(1)e^{-2\beta} + \sigma_{-1}(2)e^{-4\beta} + \sigma_{-1}(3)e^{-6\beta} + \cdots\right\}$
$= \frac{1}{4}\log\left(\frac{\alpha}{\beta}\right) - \frac{\alpha-\beta}{12}.$
Similarly from (22) we can obtain the following results.
If $\alpha\beta = \pi^2/4$ and $r$ is any positive integer excluding 0,

(30) $\alpha^r\left\{\frac{1^{2r-1}}{\cosh\alpha} - \frac{3^{2r-1}}{\cosh 3\alpha} + \frac{5^{2r-1}}{\cosh 5\alpha} - \cdots\right\}$
$+(-\beta)^r\left\{\frac{1^{2r-1}}{\cosh\beta} - \frac{3^{2r-1}}{\cosh 3\beta} + \frac{5^{2r-1}}{\cosh 5\beta} - \cdots\right\} = 0$
In other words
